en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large group of uniformed soldiers in long coats standing in formation in front of a wooden building with several chimneys and a gabled entrance. A tall ladder leans against the roof. Printed captions in red below the image read "St. Michel." on the left and "Mikkelissä." on the right. Publisher information is printed vertically at the left margin.
